title: Send project messages
responsibility: Sends questions, plans, code requests and human comments while keeping conversation text with its project.

inputs.name: projectAgentActions.agent
inputs.description: Mutable project-agent state with the workspace, permissions, bridge, conversation, and run lifecycle fields used by this action. Starting a run requires an inactive, allowed agent with a project ID; saving a comment requires a snapshot, comment capability, and comment method.

inputs.name: projectAgentActions.draft
inputs.description: The selected mode, provider, model, effort, message text, and optional design settings used to build a project request. Plan mode uses intent create and includes design settings only when supplied; other modes use the current snapshot revision and up to the last 20 messages, truncated to 4,000 characters each.

inputs.name: projectAgentComment.agent
inputs.description: Mutable project-agent state with the workspace, permissions, bridge, conversation, and run lifecycle fields used by this action. Starting a run requires an inactive, allowed agent with a project ID; saving a comment requires a snapshot, comment capability, and comment method.

inputs.name: projectAgentComment.text
inputs.description: The comment text passed to the bridge and appended to the local conversation after a successful save. It is anchored to the current snapshot revision and entity ID, or harness.project.discussion when no entity ID is available.

outputs.name: projectAgentActions
outputs.description: Resolves to the value supplied through the agent settlement callback after the run is accepted; it returns false when the agent is active, disallowed, missing a project ID, or a caught request step fails. This function has no timeout for the settlement callback.

outputs.name: projectAgentComment
outputs.description: Resolves true after the bridge comment call succeeds and the comment is added to local conversation history; status distinguishes GitHub-shared from device-only saves. Resolves false when a required snapshot, project ID, comment capability, or bridge method is absent, or a caught save step fails.
